items.t: Lidocaine (lignocaine), IV, 50–100 mg (1–2 mg/kg) initially as a slow IV injection over 2 minutes. · Repeat at 5-minute intervals if required to a total of 200–300 mg.
Lidocaine (lignocaine), IV infusion, 1–3 mg/minute for 24–30 hours.
Lidocaine jelly, topical, 2 g/100mL. · For urethral catheterisation: female 5–7 mL, male 10–15 mL.

dosing.h: Hypoxia-ischaemia of the Newborn (Perinatal Hypoxia/hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy (HIE))

items.t: Lidocaine (lignocaine), IV. · Loading dose: 2 mg/kg over 10 minutes.
Lidocaine (lignocaine), IV. · Loading dose: 2 mg/kg administered over 10 minutes.

cautions.t: Calculate the maximum dose by weight before infiltration (lower without adrenaline)

adverse_effects.t: Toxicity: perioral tingling, tinnitus, seizures, arrhythmias, cardiac arrest
